title: Hurricane Reticule
author: lgastako
rules:
Here is my latest puzzle. It's much trickier than my usual fare. It's somewhere in the 2-3 star range, and I find I tend to over-estimate these things, so I'm going to list it at 2-star, but I'l let the votes decide in the end. I hope you enjoy it. As always, feedback is welcome and encouraged.

• Normal Sudoku Rules: Fill each row, column, and 3x3 box with the digits 1-9 once each.

• White Kropkis/Black Kropkis: Digits in cells separated by a white dot are consecutive. Digits in cells separated by a black dot have a 1:2 ratio.

• German Whispers: Along green lines, digits must differ from their neighbors by at least 5.

• Palindrome Lines: Digits along a gray palindrome line must read the same forwards and backwards in either direction.

Play online using Sudokupad
